name: Frontken Corporation Berhad
overview: 2026年，Frontken 的主要子公司 AGTC 在台湾台南以 NTD 920,000,000（约 RM 118,161,120）收购工业用地及现有厂房，用于扩大营运基地。其余公告主要为公司治理、股息及季度业绩事项，未披露其他业务板块的扩张、缩减或合约动态。
overview_en: In 2026, Frontken's major subsidiary AGTC acquired an industrial land together with existing factory buildings in Tainan, Taiwan, for NTD 920,000,000 (approximately RM 118,161,120) to expand its operating base. Other announcements mainly relate to corporate governance, dividend and quarterly results, with no other disclosed expansion, reduction or contract developments for the business segments.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 集团层面今年主要动态为主要子公司 AGTC 在台湾台南收购工业用地及厂房。
segments.note_en: At group level, the main development this year was the acquisition of industrial land and factory buildings in Tainan, Taiwan, by major subsidiary AGTC.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 主要子公司 AGTC 于2026年9月15日以 NTD 920,000,000（约 RM 118,161,120）成功竞得位于台湾台南的工业用地及现有厂房。
actions.text_en: Major subsidiary AGTC successfully bidded for an industrial land together with existing factory buildings in Tainan, Taiwan, for NTD 920,000,000 (approximately RM 118,161,120) on 15 September 2026.
